sample_unit: cases (thoracic and male pelvic radiotherapy planning CT)

links.outcome: Auto-segmentation accuracy versus expert manual contours on local clinical cases, typical versus atypical
links.effect: Typical thorax DSC 0.856, HD95 6.89 mm; atypical thorax DSC 0.808 (p=0.0457), HD95 12.22 mm (p=0.0002); pelvis atypical HD95 6.16 mm vs 4.11 mm (p=0.0075).
links.quote: However, performance declined in atypical cohorts (thorax: mean DSC 0.808, p = 0.0457, mean HD95 12.22 mm, p = 0.0002; male pelvis: mean DSC 0.828, p = 0.1620, mean HD95 6.16 mm, p = 0.0075).

links.outcome: Dosimetric impact of DL contour errors, including missed dose constraint violations
links.effect: Dosimetric evaluation identified one critical false-negative error where a dose constraint violation was overlooked when the DL contour was used.
links.quote: Furthermore, the dosimetric evaluation identified one critical false-negative error where a dose constraint violation was overlooked when the DL contour was used.

links.outcome: Errors in AI auto-contours in atypical anatomy needing expert review
links.effect: Accuracy declined in atypical cases with artifacts or altered anatomy (femoral head replacement DSC 0.754; unilateral atelectasis DSC 0.784); authors conclude rigorous visual verification and expert manual review are essential.
links.quote: For clinical implementation, rigorous visual verification and manual review by experts are essential, particularly for atypical cases and organs in high-dose gradient regions.

screen.reason: Retrospective validation study evaluating the performance and failure modes/pitfalls of commercial/novel auto-segmentation software (RatoGuide) across typical and atypical real-world clinical cases.
